<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/readyz"}
#docs
200 when Postgres answers and the `graphile_worker` schema is installed; 503 otherwise, with `db` and `queue` naming which one failed. Readiness pulls the process out of rotation without killing it. It does NOT report the billing worker — a dead clock must not take the API offline; the worker answers its own `/readyz` for that.

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `string` | `ready` when every dependency answers, `not_ready` otherwise. One of `ready`, `not_ready`. |
| `service` | `string` | The service name. |
| `db` | `string` | The database state. One of `up`, `down`, `unknown`. |
| `queue` | `string` | The job queue state. One of `up`, `down`, `unknown`. |
| `env` | `string` | The runtime environment. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Ready for traffic |
| `503` | A dependency is unavailable |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/readyz"
```

#response
```json [200 OK]
{
  "status": "ready",
  "service": "tmbilling-api",
  "db": "up",
  "queue": "up",
  "env": "production"
}
```
::
